faq.question: Q1. What is PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (PDKV) has announced a walk-in interview recruitment for Research Associates and Assistant Research Associate posts under the Crop Pest Surveillance and Advisory Project-2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Research Associates and Assistant Research Associate posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for PDKV posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 15 October 2026 at 11:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the PDKV walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the chamber of Head, Department of Entomology, PGI, Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Research Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Agril. Entomology/Pl. Pathology, knowledge of computer with MS-CIT, and minimum one year experience of Research Associate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Assistant Research Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Agriculture or allied degree with knowledge of computer with MS-CIT.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for PDKV posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 38 years, with age relaxation applicable as per rule SC, ST, DT, NT, OBC.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Research Associate?
faq.answer: Research Associates receive Rs. 61,000/- + HRA per month for M.Sc. or Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month for Ph.D.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application proforma from the official website at pdkv.ac.in.
